title: Design System: 生理期倒计时

body.purpose: Chinese copy, headings, dates, controls, and status text.

shadows.name: sheet-separation
shadows.purpose: Separate the desktop editor sheet from the countdown surface.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift transient confirmation above the active surface.

motion.name: sheet-entry
motion.purpose: Move the editor sheet in from the right by 24px.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Hover and color transitions on compact controls.

components.name: Countdown Readout
components.description: The single focal value in the first viewport.
components.css: .ds-countdown { min-height: 160px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; color: #15181d; font: 740 19px/1 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-countdown strong { color: #ca4164; font: 800 128px/1 'Manrope Display', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one principal command on the countdown and sheet footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #15181d; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 18px; color: #fff; background: #15181d; font: 720 14px/1.7 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; transition: transform 140ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2b3037; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #416e9f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet cancel or fallback command.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #cbd0d6; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 18px; color: #15181d; background: #fff; font: 720 14px/1.7 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #416e9f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Password Input
components.description: Password protection appears only inside the editor.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #15181d; font: 720 12px/1.7 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #cbd0d6; border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 12px; color: #15181d; background: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.7 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #416e9f; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #416e9f; }

components.name: Sync Footer
components.description: A subordinate line that keeps cloud state explicit.
components.css: .ds-sync { height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e5e9; color: #68717d; background: #f7f8fa; font: 400 11px/1.7 -apple-system, 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-sync span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2f7864; }

narrative.overview: This system answers one private, practical question with a single commanding number. Cool white space, graphite typography, fine neutral rules, and one berry focal accent make the next expected date understandable within seconds without turning a personal utility into a health dashboard. Routine viewing remains nearly weightless; correction appears only in a deliberate full-height editor. Cloud availability, cached read-only behavior, overdue state, saving, success, and failure stay explicit through restrained functional color and plain language rather than decorative wellness imagery.
keyCharacteristics: One centered countdown dominates the first viewport.
Main content sits on pure white; the sync footer alone uses a quiet cool-gray field.
Graphite carries structure, berry carries the focal number, and functional colors carry state only.
Editing is a deliberate right-side sheet on desktop and a full-width sheet on mobile.
Thin rules, compact controls, and restrained radii replace cards, glass, and ornamental chrome.

rules.name: The Berry Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: Berry belongs to the countdown, prediction emphasis, and destructive or corrective details; it never becomes a broad background wash.

rules.name: The Numeral Monopolizes Display Rule
rules.body: Manrope Display 800 is reserved for the focal day count; headings, buttons, dates, and Chinese copy stay in the system CJK UI stack.

rules.name: The One-Question Rule
rules.body: Keep the first viewport centered on the countdown, predicted date, one update task, and sync state; additional records and predictions belong behind the editor.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use whitespace, tone, and rules; reserve shadows for overlays that must separate from active content.

dos: Do keep the countdown and predicted date legible within seconds, with the day count as the only display-scale element.
Do keep the main canvas Main White, the sync footer Sync Mist, and the focal numeral Countdown Berry.
Do use Readable Muted (#68717d) for normal secondary copy and Focus Blue (#416e9f) for the visible 3px keyboard ring.
Do preserve cloud and cached read-only clarity before exposing edit controls.
Do use tabular numerals for dates and changing countdown values.
donts: Don't add dashboard density, metric grids, decorative wellness chrome, glass, gradients, or ornamental cards.
Don't spread berry across large surfaces or use green, amber, and blue outside their documented functional meanings.
Don't use Manrope Display for body copy, Chinese headings, labels, or controls.
Don't hide connection, saving, overdue, or error meaning behind color or icons alone.
Don't exceed the restrained 6-10px control-radius language except for true circles and the incidental scrollbar pill.
